evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: A conceptual distinction asserted as self-evident logic — rational persuasion via definitional framing, no external authority invoked.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Logical revaluation (commodity vs asset) carries an aspirational pull — 'the asset you keep' appeals to what one should value and retain.
